label: AppleScript keystroke into Slack, sanitized from a real session
command:
osascript <<'AS'
tell application "Slack" to activate
delay 0.8
tell application "System Events"
  tell process "Slack"
    set frontmost to true
    keystroke "3"
    key code 36
  end tell
end tell
AS

label: AppleScript click at a computed window coordinate
command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Slack" to click at {753, 422}'

label: ffmpeg screen recording of the user's display
wrapper script the command merely runs

script.body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
